title: Area Survey App
description: Use this application to make an exact plot of a room, a property or any two dimensional area. Measure distances and angles, calculate side lengths, diagonals and angles. Export the plot to Sketchup or other CAD systems.

components.content:
## How to Use

1. Make the reference line A - B (a virtual or physical line between two points)
2. Measure the distance A - B
3. Mark measure points clockwise from 1 to 9
4. Measure distances from control points A and B to each measure point
5. Click Calculate to generate the survey plot

**Plot Colors:**
- Control line A - B: **black**
- Measured lines: **purple**
- Calculated sides and angles: **red**
- Calculated diagonals: **green**

inputs.label: A - B Distance
inputs.unit: m, mm, ft, in (specify your unit)

components.content:
## Calculated Results

After entering your measurements and clicking Calculate, the following will be computed:

- **Calculated Angles**: Internal angles at each measured point
- **Calculated Sides**: Side lengths connecting consecutive points
- **Calculated Diagonals**: Diagonal distances across the surveyed area

## Export Options

**Sketchup Export**: Copy the Cartesian x,y coordinates to paste into the Engineering ToolBox extension "Lines made from Custom Points"

**SVG File**: Export as SVG format for use with drawing, CAD and web applications

**CAD Compatible**: Plain Cartesian coordinates can be transferred to almost any CAD system
